00026 /**

00028  *
00029  * HxRegionNew creates a new HxRegion_t object.  This function allocates
00030  * an HxRegion_t structure, and HxRegionDelete must be called to
00031  * deallocate it.
00032  *
00033  * If pRect is set to NULL, an uninitialized region is returned.  If the
00034  * region is not initialized, HxRegionAddRectangle must be called before
00035  * using it.

00038  * @param hRegion       OUT:    Pointer to the new HxRegion_t object
00039  *
00040  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.
00041  *                              Returns HX_NULL_POINTER if hRegion is NULL.
00042  *
00043  **/
00044 HxResult HxRegionNew(const HxRectangle_t* pRect, HxRegion_t** hRegion);

00103 /**

00105  *
00106  * HxRegionOffset moves the HxRegion_t object by adding x and y to its
00107  * origin.  If x and y is positive, the movement is to the right and down.
00108  * If x and y is negative, the movement is to the left and up.
00109  *
00110  * @param pRegion       IN/OUT: Pointer to the HxRegion_t object
00111  * @param x             IN:     horizontal offset
00112  * @param x             IN:     vertical offset
00113  *
00114  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.
00115  *                              Returns HX_NULL_POINTER if pRegion is NULL.
00116  *
00117  **/
00118 HxResult HxRegionOffset(HxRegion_t* pRegion, int32_t x, int32_t y);
